hits.vignette: A 22-year-old man reports several years of progressively worsening vision in dim light. He now frequently bumps into objects approaching from either side but can still read small print in good lighting. Funduscopic examination shows bilateral midperipheral bone-spicule pigmentation and attenuated retinal vessels. There is no ocular pain or acute change in vision.
hits.lead_in: In the typical form of this disorder, which of the following retinal cell populations is preferentially affected early in the disease process?
hits.tested_construct: Retinitis pigmentosa is a genetically heterogeneous group of inherited retinal dystrophies. In the typical rod-cone form, rod photoreceptors are preferentially affected early. Progressive rod dysfunction causes nyctalopia and peripheral visual-field loss; cone dysfunction develops later and can impair color and central vision. Retinal pigment epithelium becomes secondarily abnormal, and migrating pigment-containing cells contribute to the characteristic bone-spicule fundus appearance.

hits.vignette: A 24-year-old man has progressive retinitis pigmentosa, anosmia, peripheral neuropathy, ataxia, and ichthyosis. Plasma phytanic acid is markedly elevated, whereas very-long-chain fatty acid concentrations are normal.
hits.lead_in: Which metabolic process is most directly impaired?
hits.tested_construct: Most adult Refsum disease is caused by biallelic PHYH variants that impair peroxisomal phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase, blocking alpha-oxidation of phytanic acid and causing systemic phytanic-acid accumulation.

hits.vignette: An 8-year-old boy has progressive dystonia, dysarthria, rigidity, and pigmentary retinal degeneration. T2-weighted MRI shows the characteristic eye-of-the-tiger appearance of the globus pallidus. Genetic testing identifies biallelic loss-of-function variants in PANK2.
hits.lead_in: Which reaction is catalyzed by the deficient enzyme?
hits.tested_construct: PANK2 is a pantothenate kinase that phosphorylates pantothenate at the entry step of coenzyme A biosynthesis
